data.name: Cloud Burst
data.description: Changes the Pokémon's form when HP is halved.

data.name: Shackled Soul
data.description: The user is enchained and its speed is halved. If hit by an attack, the shackles break, increasing speed. The chains reform after 3 turns.

data.description: Powers up moves used in succession.

data.name: Scalate

data.name: Equalize
data.description: Normal-type moves become Sound-type and powered up.

data.name: Conflagrate
data.description: Normal-type moves become Fire-type and powered up.

data.name: Tag Curse
data.description: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Tag Curse.

data.name: Hive Shield
data.description: The Pokémon's subjects shield them from indirect damage.

data.name: Tempo Boost
data.description: When hit by a Sound move, reduces damage and raises Speed by 1 stage.

data.name: Primal Power
data.description: The user takes half damage from and deals 50% more damage with Fighting type moves.

data.name: Sun Blessed
data.description: Under sun, Water moves deal normal damage, and can heal status for itself and ally.

data.name: Striker
data.description: Kicking moves deal 30% more damage.

data.name: Subzero
data.description: The user deals 50% more damage with Ice Type moves and is immune to Frostbite.

data.name: Dread Aura
data.description: A dreadful aura reduces all opponents' Attack and Special Attack.

data.name: Dishearten
data.description: Upon entry, the enemy is discouraged and their Special Attack is reduced.

data.name: Erotoxin
data.description: Any Pokémon poisoned by the user also becomes infatuated with them.

data.name: Caustic Fumes
data.description: Upon entry, calls forth Acid Rain for 5 Turns.
